info.title: agentfn-cli
info.description: Official command-line client for AgentFn user and Credential Client workflows.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Publish, run, inspect, and manage AgentFn resources.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --base-url
options.description: AgentFn host URL; overrides profile configuration and AGENTFN_BASE_URL. Defaults to https://agentfn.io-vii.com.

options.name: --config
options.description: CLI configuration file, or AGENTFN_CONFIG_FILE.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Configuration profile, or AGENTFN_PROFILE.

options.name: --token
options.description: Bearer Access Token. auth login saves it; business commands use it once with highest precedence.

options.name: --token-stdin
options.description: Read a Bearer Access Token from redirected standard input instead of the command line. [default: False]

options.name: --client-id
options.description: OAuth Client ID; pair with --client-private-key and --client-key-id for private_key_jwt login.

options.name: --client-private-key
options.description: RSA private-key PEM path for Credential Client JWT assertions, or AGENTFN_CLIENT_PRIVATE_KEY.

options.name: --client-key-id
options.description: JWKS key ID (kid) for Credential Client JWT assertions, or AGENTFN_CLIENT_KEY_ID.

options.name: --scope
options.description: OAuth scope. Repeatable, or use AGENTFN_SCOPES. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --token-endpoint
options.description: Override the OAuth token endpoint, or use AGENTFN_TOKEN_ENDPOINT.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output mode: interactive for people, subprocess for Agent integration. [default: interactive]

options.name: --anonymous
options.description: Allow unauthenticated calls to a development host. [default: False]

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Log in, inspect, and clear CLI authentication profiles.

commands.name: login
commands.description: Log in a normal user or Credential Client and save the selected profile.

options.name: --identity
options.description: Login identity: user for authorization-code + PKCE, or client for Client Credentials. [default: user]

options.name: --no-browser
options.description: Print the authorization or verification URL instead of opening a browser. [default: False]

options.name: --device-code
options.description: Use OAuth Device Authorization Flow; suitable for terminals without a local browser. [default: False]

options.name: --authorization-code
options.description: Exchange an externally obtained user authorization code without prompting.

options.name: --code-verifier
options.description: PKCE verifier paired with --authorization-code.

options.name: --redirect-uri
options.description: Explicit HTTP loopback callback URI; interactive login otherwise binds a free 127.0.0.1 port.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for user authorization. [default: 300]

commands.name: authorize
commands.description: Generate a user authorization URL and PKCE verifier for a headless login flow.

options.name: --redirect-uri
options.description: Explicit HTTP loopback callback URI; otherwise a free 127.0.0.1 port is selected.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the selected profile without revealing credentials.

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Remove saved authentication from the selected profile.

commands.name: account
commands.description: Inspect the current authenticated User account.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show the current authenticated User and Provider Token metadata.

options.name: --page
